runs.t: Which practical project example best illustrates

options.text: For a multi-tenant booking API, test broken object-level access using another tenant's reservation ID; test injection at search filters and verify secrets are absent from error responses.
A new document-upload feature starts with allowed file types and authorization policy, then gets security tests, scan controls, release checks and production alerts.
A file upload passes through size/type checks, malware scanning, private object storage, signed access URLs and monitoring. None alone should be assumed perfect.
A payment webhook crosses an external trust boundary. Threats include forged callbacks, replay, payload tampering and resource exhaustion; mitigations include signature checks, event IDs and limits.
